figurative_meaning_bn: ভিড় করে হল্লা করা; উদ্দাম নাচানাচি
figurative_meaning_en: Making a commotion with a crowd; wild and unrestrained revelry
example_sentences_in_bangla: রাতভর পাড়ায় হৈ-হুল্লোড় করে তারা ঘুমাতে দিল না।
example_sentences_in_english: There was a hullabaloo at the wedding ceremony.
They made a racket all night, not letting the neighborhood sleep.
note: The idiom captures the lively, often chaotic energy of Bengali social gatherings.
